maintenance_led.reason: Oilfield services and equipment for well construction, completions, drilling and production; much is new-well activity, not mainly maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are oil and gas operators, including national oil companies like PDO, paying for services; commercial energy producers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through its own technology and service contracts; no steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Downhole tools, managed pressure drilling and well integrity services are safety-critical and designed into well programs; switching mid-well is risky.
